description: Rank 1 is highest priority. YouTube channel entries accept channelUrl using https://www.youtube.com/@handle/live; channelId is optional because the room can resolve the handle. Add a free, referrer-restricted YouTube Data API v3 key to youtubeApiKey. The TV finds a currently LIVE public video and embeds that video muted. Twitch entries are enabled/disabled manually. Optional videoId keeps a fixed-video fallback.
